description: This file defines the MockTemperatureMeasurementCluster class, a mock implementation for temperature measurement in a device cluster, including attribute management and accessors.

classes.name: MockTemperatureMeasurementCluster
classes.description: A mock implementation of a temperature measurement device cluster, enabling setting and retrieving temperature data for testing purposes.

methods.name: setMeasuredTemperature
methods.description: Sets the current measured temperature value.

methods.name: getMeasuredTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves the current measured temperature value.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Returns the byte array representing the attribute data for a given attribute info.
